tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and Conditions As per tender Documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Submit the tenderer's name and address, phone number, and full address information on a letterhead.
The E.M.D amount of Rs. 37,500.00 (only thirty-seven thousand five hundred) should be paid only through the KPPP Portal.
Mandatory submission of a food safety certificate currently active under competent authority (FSSAI).
The ITR reports for the years 2024-25 and 2025-26 must be submitted mandatorily.
Submit a self-attested copy of Aadhar Card and PAN Card
Bidders should not be on the blacklist. An affidavit certificate on a Rs. 100/- stamp paper should be submitted regarding this.
